name: Pokémon Ruby & Sapphire
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. Original Pokemon Ruby & Sapphire teams (NOT Emerald line-ups). Species and levels taken from Bulbapedia party data; abilities, held items and moves intentionally left blank (null/[]) in this v1 boss data.
